prompt:
Pixel art for a 16-bit style side-view arena shooter that runs at 640x360. Edit the attached template in place: it is drawn on a chunky pixel grid where one art pixel is exactly 1/240 of the image width; keep exactly that pixel size (never finer, never subdivided), and keep every size anchor and guide position. Crisp hard pixels: a clean 1-pixel near-black outline around every character, Enemy and prop; flat cel shading with 3-4 tones per material, shadows leaning purple-blue and highlights leaning warm yellow, light from the upper left; no anti-aliasing, no gradients, no blur, no soft edges, no semi-transparent pixels (use a checkerboard dither for any in-between tone). Characters are seen in a three-quarter side view (Metal Slug style): facing right, head and chest turned slightly toward the viewer. No text, no watermark, no shadows on the ground unless asked.

The attached image is one 240x135 tile of the Arena backdrop, a 640x360 opaque side-view scene, drawn as a flat draft at its exact in-game pixel size. The Arena is a city plaza at sunset between a classical columned courthouse (left) and the glass Bufete & Pesas S.A. tower (right), with the Boissons cocktail bar on the plaza between them.

This tile: the top right of the scene: open sunset sky with thin horizontal streaks; a large rooftop billboard of the Bufete & Pesas S.A. gym on top of the glass tower: a yellow board with a dark frame, a dumbbell and a gavel drawn on its left part, its right part a blank yellow field, five small lamp arms along its top edge and steel legs holding it on the tower roof; below it the roof slab and the top floors of the blue glass curtain-wall tower.

Redraw this tile in place as crisp, finished, professional pixel art (modern commercial 16-bit quality), at exactly the same pixel size and composition. Every shape stays exactly where it is, within one pixel, so this tile joins its neighbours: the same silhouettes, edges, window grids and horizon lines. Keep the colours and the warm sunset light from the left. Add hand-placed detail: a bold chunky dumbbell with shaded iron plates and a wooden gavel with a banded head on the billboard, a thin bevel and soft shading on the yellow board, riveted steel legs, sunset reflections on the glass panes, and crisp stepped edges on the sky streaks. Keep the right part of the billboard a completely blank, flat yellow field (its lettering is added later), and keep the top 32 rows of sky calm and flat. A dark 1-pixel outline only where a building meets the sky. Opaque scene: fill the whole frame edge to edge, no border, no white background, no text.
